title: Ordering two shadow colors (demo)
question: When painting shadows with two colors, should the darker or lighter color be applied first?
stopped: Every research point has a source location (the demo uses only two sources)

claims.claim: Applying the darker color first reduces muddy boundaries
claims.note: Both a first-hand account and a paper report this.

quotes.text: わたしは影を塗るとき、まず一番暗い色を先に置く。 明るい影から置くと、あとで暗い影を重ねたときに境目が濁るからだ。
In 9 of 12 cases, placing the darkest tone first produced fewer visible seams at layer boundaries.
quotes.zh: 在12个案例中，有9个案例先铺最深色调时，图层边界处可见的接缝更少。

claims.claim: Conditions under which the difference disappears
claims.note: Only one sentence in the paper; it does not say how much blending is required.

quotes.text: The effect disappeared when layers were blended with a soft brush.
quotes.zh: 使用软笔刷混合图层后，这种差异消失了。

disagreements.topic: Whether watercolor uses the reverse order

quotes.text: ただし水彩の場合は逆で、明るい色から重ねるのが定石だと聞く。 自分は水彩を描かないので、ここは確かめていない。

unreached: A first-hand test of watercolor layer order (not found in this demo scenario)
